statement: We set out to build the most faithful Game Boy we could. Now anyone in the world can put it to the test.

entries.text: **A Game Boy test page at /gbtest/.** It runs the same Game Boy emulator the site plays games on, with nothing else in the way: choose Game Boy, Game Boy Color or Super Game Boy, then a test file, and the picture appears on a plain 160 x 144 screen, one pixel per Game Boy pixel, with no colour correction, blending or border. Our own start-up programs run first, so a test starts from the same state as on the console. Public test boards can drive it to score the emulator.
